swayable.summary: A politician argues that Governor Tim Walz is dangerous and reckless for allegedly ordering the Minnesota National Guard to resist federal agents, and calls for his resignation. The video is a single speaker delivering rapid, heated accusations directly to camera or in an interview setting.
swayable.title: Rep. Mace Calls Walz Dangerous, Demands His Resignation

traits.change: Add an opening line such as: 'As a veteran who served this country, I know what it means to follow the chain of command — and Walz is breaking it.'

traits.quote: Trump is the commander in chief.
traits.change: Drop the contrast by removing the line 'Trump is the commander in chief' and focusing only on Walz's actions without referencing Trump's authority.
Add a note in the production brief to shoot in a formal studio or official setting with professional lighting and a clean backdrop instead of what sounds like an off-the-cuff interview.
Add a line such as: 'Hardworking Minnesotans and Americans everywhere are scared of what their own governor is doing to them.'

traits.quote: I agree with Vice President Bance that he should too resign.
traits.change: To remove this trait, replace the speaker with a non-politician such as a local resident or law enforcement officer delivering the same message.
Add a line such as: 'I heard directly from a Minnesota National Guard family member who was horrified by the order Walz issued.'
Add a closing line such as: 'Support leaders who will keep America safe — not governors like Walz who put us all at risk.'
Add a line such as: 'We have the power right now to demand he step down and protect this country — and I know we will!'

traits.quote: the warning order he issued to the Minnesota National Guard uh to come in potentially and take up arms against the federal government and ICE agents
traits.change: To remove this, cut the sentence about the warning order and replace it with a purely emotional appeal about danger without describing the specific action.

traits.quote: I agree with Vice President Bance that he should too resign.
traits.change: To remove this, cut the line 'I agree with Vice President Bance that he should too resign' and keep only the speaker's own direct opinion.
Add a closing line such as: 'America is stronger than this, and I am proud of every official standing up to protect our federal agents and our laws.'

traits.quote: the warning order he issued to the Minnesota National Guard uh to come in potentially and take up arms against the federal government and ICE agents
traits.change: To remove this, cut the specific claim about the warning order and replace it with general language about Walz being dangerous without introducing a specific new allegation.
Add a dry line such as: 'Apparently in Tim Walz's Minnesota, the National Guard works for him — not the United States of America.'
Replace or supplement the politician speaker with a well-known public figure who is not a politician to deliver the core message.
To remove anger, replace 'This is a dangerous guy' and similar charged phrases with calm, measured language such as 'These actions raise serious legal and constitutional questions.'

traits.quote: including uh the warning order he issued to the Minnesota National Guard uh to come in potentially
traits.change: To make it sound more scripted, remove the filler words 'uh' and tighten the sentences so they flow cleanly without hesitation.
Add a line such as: 'Law enforcement officers across Minnesota have told me they are grateful the federal government is stepping in to restore order.'
Add a line such as: 'Under Walz, Minnesota spent X million in taxpayer dollars on programs later flagged for fraud, and violent incidents against officers rose by X percent.'
Add a closing line such as: 'With the right leadership, Minnesota and America can be safe, lawful, and strong again.'

traits.quote: He needs to step down for the safety of America and the safety of motans.
traits.change: To remove the negative tone, cut the resignation demand and replace it with a forward-looking line about what good governance would look like instead.

traits.quote: including uh the warning order he issued to the Minnesota National Guard uh to come in potentially
traits.change: To remove the amateur feel, re-record the segment in a controlled setting with a prepared script so there are no filler words or stumbles.
Add a line such as: 'According to reporting from [news outlet], Walz issued a warning order to the Minnesota National Guard on [date].'
Add on-screen text displaying key claims such as 'Walz issued warning order to MN National Guard' as the speaker says them.
Add a brief clip of an everyday Minnesotan saying: 'I'm a regular citizen here and I don't feel safe with what my governor is doing.'

traits.quote: This guy is very dangerous and needs to be needs to not be governor.
traits.change: To remove the opinion advocacy, cut 'This guy is very dangerous and needs to not be governor' and replace it with a neutral statement of the facts only.
Add a line such as: 'It is a sad day when an American governor turns the National Guard against the very federal government they swore to serve.'

traits.quote: I'm deeply concerned about his recklessness in other ways that might be criminal
